facts.text: I am thinking of grilling burgers this weekend.
I want to try a new topping for my burgers.
I have found that cheddar cheese goes well with bacon on a burger.
I am intrigued by the mushroom duxelles idea.
I want to cook bacon for my burger so it is crispy but not burnt.
I plan to pan-fry the bacon.
I want the burger to be assembled so everything stays together and the flavors combine well.
I want suggestions for sides to serve with my burger.
I want sides that complement the flavors and do not overpower the dish.
I will serve coleslaw and French fries with my burger.
I think creamy coleslaw will help balance the richness of the burger.
I think crispy French fries will add a satisfying crunch.
